name: Assassins
description: The Assassins were a youth street gang ("jitterbugging" gang) based in Harlem, New York, active during the 1950s. They operated in both West Harlem and East Harlem and are documented in connection with incidents involving other Manhattan gangs of the era, including the Scotchmen, Copians, Dragons, and Sinners.
